```{r Seurat T cell - SCTransform, harmony and clustering}
library(harmony) #batch correction
seurat_T <- readRDS(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\seurat_obj\\seurat_T.rds"))
seurat_T <- SCTransform(seurat_T, assay = "RNA", verbose = TRUE, vars.to.regress = c("percent.mt"), return.only.var.genes = FALSE, min_cells = 0) #Transform RNA. Also Scale and find variable features

#remove TCR, BCR, Mito and Ribosome from feature selection
DefaultAssay(seurat_T) <- "SCT"
VariableFeatures(seurat_T) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(seurat_T),
grep("^MT-|^RP[SL]|^TR[ABGD][VDJ]|^IG[HKL]",  VariableFeatures(seurat_T), value = TRUE) 
)


#Run UMAP on non corrected data
seurat_T <- RunPCA(seurat_T, assay = "SCT", npcs = 50, reduction.name = "pca_unintegrated", features = VariableFeatures(seurat_T))
ElbowPlot(seurat_T, reduction = "pca_unintegrated") #look at elbow curve and use it to rerun PCA: Always use more dims if unsure

seurat_T <- seurat_T %>% 
  RunPCA(npcs = 19, reduction.name = "pca_unintegrated", features = VariableFeatures(seurat_T)) %>% 
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:19, reduction = "pca_unintegrated") %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = .5, algorithm = 4, cluster.name = "clusters_unintegrated") %>% 
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:19, reduction = "pca_unintegrated", reduction.name = "umap_unintegrated")
DimPlot(seurat_T, reduction = "umap_unintegrated", group.by = c("batch", "clusters_unintegrated"))


seurat_T <- seurat_T %>% 
  RunHarmony(group.by.vars = "batch", reduction.use = "pca_unintegrated",  reduction.save = "pca_harmony", theta = 4) %>% 
  RunUMAP(reduction = "pca_harmony", dims = 1:19, reduction.name = "umap_harmony") %>% 
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "pca_harmony", dims = 1:19) %>% 
  FindClusters(resolution = .5, algorithm = 4, cluster.name = "clusters_harmony")

seurat_T %>% DimPlot(reduction = "umap_harmony", group.by = c("clusters_harmony"), label = TRUE) #check clustering


svglite(filename = paste0(filepath_plots, "T_cells\\QC_Batch_Harmony.svg"), height = 8, width = 10)
ggarrange(DimPlot(seurat_T, reduction = "umap_unintegrated", group.by = c("batch", "clusters_unintegrated"), pt.size = .2, shuffle = TRUE), 
          DimPlot(seurat_T, reduction = "umap_harmony", group.by = c("batch", "clusters_harmony"), pt.size = .2, shuffle = TRUE), 
          nrow = 2)
dev.off()


#QC only T cells
FeaturePlot(seurat_T, reduction = "umap_harmony" ,features = c("CD14", "CD19", "MS4A1", "CD3E", "CD8A", "CD4"))
VlnPlot(seurat_T, features = c("CD14", "CD19", "MS4A1", "CD3E", "CD8A", "CD4"))

#Plot some marker to see distribution
FeaturePlot(seurat_T, reduction = "umap_harmony" ,features = c("CD8A","IL4", "IL5", "IL13", "IFNG", "GATA3", "TBX21", "RORC", "FOXP3", "TNFRSF9", "CD40LG", "PTGDR2"))
VlnPlot(seurat_T, features = c("CD8A","IL4", "IL5", "IL13", "IFNG", "GATA3", "TBX21", "RORC", "FOXP3", "TNFRSF9", "CD40LG", "PTGDR2"))

#Plot PCA harmony info
ElbowPlot(seurat_T, reduction = "pca_harmony")
VizDimLoadings(seurat_T, dims = 1:4, reduction = "pca_unintegrated") #not computed for harmony
DimPlot(seurat_T, reduction = "pca_harmony", dims = c(1,2) ,group.by = "group", alpha = 0.5, shuffle = TRUE) 
DimPlot(seurat_T, reduction = "pca_harmony", dims = c(1,2) ,group.by = "batch", alpha = 0.5, shuffle = TRUE) 
DimHeatmap(seurat_T, dims = c(1:18), reduction = "pca_harmony", cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)


seurat_T <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(seurat_T) #prep SCT model
SetIdent(seurat_T, value = "clusters_harmony")
all(seurat_T@active.ident == seurat_T@meta.data[["clusters_harmony"]]) #check that the active ident is the harmony cluster

# Save the seurat object
saveRDS(seurat_T, file = paste0(wd, "data\\out\\seurat_obj\\seurat_Tcells_Integrated.rds"))
gc()
```

```{r Seurat ´- Cluster annotation manual}
seurat_T <- readRDS(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\seurat_obj\\seurat_Tcells_Integrated.rds"))

#Make heatmap for clusters
#remove TCR, BCR, Mito and Ribosome from feature selection

gene_exclude <- grep("^MT-|^RP[SL]|^TR[ABGD][VDJ]|^IG[HKL]",  T_markers$gene, value = TRUE) 

topgenes <- T_markers %>%
    filter(!gene %in% gene_exclude) %>% 
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 1) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    ungroup() 


mean_expr <- AverageExpression(
  seurat_T,
  features = topgenes$gene,
  group.by = "clusters_harmony",  # or any metadata column
  layer = "data",                  # use "data" for log-normalized
  assay = "SCT",
  return.seurat = FALSE
) %>% 
  as.data.frame()
colnames(mean_expr) <- paste0("Cluster_",1:12)

write.csv(mean_expr, file =paste0(wd, "data\\out\\cluster_stat\\topgene_mean_Tcells.csv"))
write.csv(T_markers, file =paste0(wd, "data\\out\\cluster_stat\\DEG_Tcells.csv"))

#Export percentage per clusters
cluster_table <- prop.table(table(seurat_T$clusters_harmony, seurat_T$sampleid), margin = 2) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename("sampleid" = "Var1", "clusters" = "Var2" ) %>% 
  left_join(seurat_T@meta.data[,c("sampleid", "visit", "day")] %>% distinct(), by = "sampleid") %>% 
  mutate(visit = case_when(str_detect(sampleid, "Unstim") ~ "V1", .default = visit),

         donor = str_extract(sampleid, "^[^_]+")

  select(sampleid, donor, visit, day, everything()) %>% 
  arrange(donor, visit, day, clusters)
```

```{r Seurat - Cluster Exhaustion score}
seurat_T <- readRDS(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\seurat_obj\\seurat_Tcells_Integrated.rds"))

#Plot timepoints in allergic
seurat_T_subset <- seurat_T %>% 
  subset(subset = group == "Allergic") %>% subset(subset = !donor == "H905")
seurat_T_subset[["Timepoint"]] <- ifelse(seurat_T_subset[["visit"]] == "V2", "mo6", 
                                         ifelse(seurat_T_subset[["visit"]] == "V1" & seurat_T_subset[["day"]] == "d0", "d0", "d7"))

seurat_T_subset_d0 <-  seurat_T_subset %>% subset(subset = Timepoint == "d0")
seurat_T_subset_d7 <-  seurat_T_subset %>% subset(subset = Timepoint == "d7") 
seurat_T_subset_mo6 <-  seurat_T_subset %>% subset(subset = Timepoint == "mo6") 


features_exhaustion <- c("PDCD1", "CTLA4", "LAG3", "TIGIT", "NR4A1", "NR4A2", "NR4A3") #Exhaustion
features_invivoact <- c("MKI67", "CD38", "HLA-DRA")

features <- c(features_invivoact, features_exhaustion)

seurat_T_subset_d0 %>% VlnPlot(features = features) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 5))
seurat_T_subset_d7 %>% VlnPlot(features = features) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 5))
seurat_T_subset_mo6 %>% VlnPlot(features = features) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 5))

seurat_T_subset %>% 
  subset(subset = Timepoint == "d0") %>% 
  FeaturePlot(reduction = "umap_harmony" ,features = features, keep.scale = "all", ncol = 1 ) + 
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text  = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())


expr <- AverageExpression(
  seurat_T,
  features = c(features_exhaustion, features_invivoact),
  assays = "SCT", layer = "data",
  group.by = c("clusters_harmony", "donor", "visit", "day")
) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = c("clusters", "donor", "visit", "day"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_to = "mean_expression"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(clusters = str_sub(clusters, 6)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "gene", values_from = "mean_expression") %>% 
  filter(!donor == "Unstim")


write.csv(expr, file =paste0(wd, "data\\out\\cluster_stat\\cluster_Tcells_exhaustion_expression.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r DEG Tregs cluster 1 vs cluster 3}
seurat_T <- readRDS(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\seurat_obj\\seurat_Tcells_Integrated.rds"))
seurat_T <- subset(seurat_T, idents = c(1, 3)) 

#Calculate DEG between cluster 1 and 3
T_markers <- FindMarkers(
  object = seurat_T,
  ident.1 = "3",
  ident.2 = "1",
  assay = "SCT",
  recorrect_umi = FALSE) %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene")

#remove nitocondrial genes and others
#set significant for colors
gene_exclude <- grep("^MT-|^RP[SL]|^TR[ABGD][VDJ]|^IG[HKL]|^ENSG|^LINC|^CD8",  T_markers$gene, value = TRUE) 
T_markers <- T_markers %>%
  filter(!gene %in% gene_exclude) %>% 
  mutate(
    significant = case_when(
      p_val_adj < 0.01 & avg_log2FC > 0.25 ~ "Up",
      p_val_adj < 0.01 & avg_log2FC < -0.25 ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
)

# Only keep top genes for label
top_genes <- T_markers %>% 
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.01) %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC < -0.45 | avg_log2FC > 0.45) %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

#plot
svglite(filename = paste0(filepath_plots, "T_cells\\DEG_Tregs.svg"), height = 4, width = 4)
T_markers %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significant), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "red", Down = "green",NS = "grey70")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.25, 0.25), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.01), linetype = "dashed") +
  
  geom_label_repel(data = top_genes, aes(label = gene), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  
  labs(x = "Log2 (Fold Change)", y = "-log10(adj. p-val)", title = "DEG cluster 3 VS cluster 1") +
  theme_pubr() + theme_fonts +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
dev.off()


```


```{r GSEA for all clusters in loop}
T_markers <- read.csv(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\cluster_stat\\DEG_Tcells.csv"))
T_markers$cluster %>% unique()
#remove TCR, BCR, Mito and Ribosome from feature selection
gene_exclude <- grep("^MT-|^RP[SL]",  T_markers$gene, value = TRUE) 

ranked_genes <- T_markers %>%
  filter(!gene %in% gene_exclude) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  group_map(~ pull(.x, avg_log2FC, name = gene), .keep = TRUE) 

#Load geneset data
library(msigdbr, fgsea)
msig_h  <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME")
pathways <- split(msig_h$gene_symbol, msig_h$gs_name)

#Initialise df
df_gsea <- data.frame(
  pathway = character(),
  pval = numeric(),
  padj = numeric(),
  log2err = numeric(),
  ES = numeric(),
  NES = numeric(),
  size = integer(),
  leadingEdge = list()
)

for(i in 1:length(ranked_genes)){
  
fgsea_res <- fgsea::fgsea(
  pathways = pathways,
  stats    = ranked_genes[[i]],
  minSize  = 5,
  maxSize  = 500
)  

# Filter significant results
sig_pathways <- fgsea_res %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(NES))) %>% 
  # filter(padj < 0.1) %>% 
  head(20) %>% 
  mutate(cluster = as.character(i)) %>% 
  select(cluster, everything())
  
df_gsea <- df_gsea %>% rbind(sig_pathways)

}

write.csv(df_gsea %>% select(-leadingEdge), file =paste0(wd, "data\\out\\cluster_stat\\GSEA_Tcells.csv"))
  

plot_enrich <- df_gsea %>% 
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = as.character(1:14)),
         pathway = str_replace(pathway, "REACTOME_", "")) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  filter(padj < 0.1) %>% 
  slice_min(order_by = padj, n = 5) %>% 
  mutate(
    pathway = paste0(cluster, "_", pathway), #bind cluster name to pathway for better ordering of the factor levels
    pathway = reorder(pathway, NES)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x = NES, y = pathway)) +
  ggh4x::facet_wrap2(~cluster, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y", axes = "all")+
  geom_point(aes(size = size, color = -log10(padj))) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub("^[0-9]+_", "", x)) + #remove the cluster information from ylabel
  labs(x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)", y = "Pathway", color = "-log10(FDR)", size = "Gene set size") + 
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)) 

png(filename = paste0(filepath_plots, "T_cells\\cluster_enrich.png"), height = 2160, width = 2160)
plot_enrich
dev.off()


df_gsea_filtered <- df_gsea %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = as.character(1:14)),
         pathway = str_replace(pathway, "REACTOME_", ""))

pathways <- df_gsea_filtered  %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>% 
  slice_min(order_by = padj, n = 3)  %>% 
  pull(pathway) %>% unique()
  
df_gsea_filtered %>% 
  filter(pathway %in% pathways) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster, y = pathway, size = NES, col = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point()

df <- df_gsea_filtered %>% 
  filter(pathway %in% pathways) %>% 
  select(cluster, pathway, NES) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "cluster", values_from = "NES") %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(., 0))) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("pathway") %>% 
  as.matrix()

Heatmap(df)
```

```{r ADT Clusters }
  geom_jitter(alpha = .2) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) + stat_cor() + 
  labs(x = "CD3E RNA", y = "CD3E Protein") +
  theme_pubr + theme_fonts 
dev.off()

# Expression per clusters

#Median CD3 per clusters
DefaultAssay(seurat_T) <- "ADT"
cd3_data <- FetchData(seurat_T, vars = c("CD3", "clusters_harmony")) %>% 
  filter(!clusters_harmony == 8)

all_cells_med <- cd3_data %>% summarize(CD3_median = median(CD3)) %>% pull(CD3_median) #median for all cells
cd3_med_fold <- cd3_data %>% 
  group_by(clusters_harmony) %>% 
  summarize(CD3_median = median(CD3)) %>% 
  mutate(CD3_median_foldchange = CD3_median / all_cells_med)

df_cd3_cluster <- cd3_data %>% mutate(clusters_harmony = "all Tcells") %>% rbind(cd3_data) %>% #compare each cluster to all cells
  wilcox_test(CD3 ~ clusters_harmony, p.adjust.method = "BH", ref.group = "all Tcells") 

df_cd3_cluster <- df_cd3_cluster %>% left_join(cd3_med_fold, by = c("group2" = "clusters_harmony")) %>% 
  select(group2, CD3_median, CD3_median_foldchange, p.adj, p.adj.signif) %>% 
  rename("clusters_harmony" = "group2") 

plot_cd3 <- cd3_data %>% 
  left_join(df_cd3_cluster, by = "clusters_harmony") %>% 
  smartbind(cd3_data %>% mutate(clusters_harmony = "all Tcells") %>% slice_sample(prop = .1)) %>% 
  mutate(fold = case_when(
          CD3_median_foldchange > 1.2 ~ "> 1.2", 
          CD3_median_foldchange < .8 ~ "< 0.8", 
          .default = "Unchanged"),
        fold = factor(fold, levels = c("> 1.2", "Unchanged", "< 0.8"))) %>% 
  mutate(clusters_harmony = factor(clusters_harmony, levels = c("all Tcells",1:15))) %>% 
  slice_sample(prop = .6, by = "clusters_harmony") %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x = clusters_harmony, y = CD3, col = fold)) +
  geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.5)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = .2, outliers = FALSE) + 
  # geom_quasirandom(method = "quasirandom", width=.3, size=.3, alpha = 0.1, varwidth=F, dodge.width=0.60) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = all_cells_med, color = "red",  linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("> 1.2" = "green", "< 0.8" = "red", "Unchanged" = "grey50")) +
  labs(color = "Fold change",x = NULL, y = "CD3E protein") +
  theme_pubr(legend = "right") + theme_grid + theme_fonts + theme_x_angled


#Median NOTCH2 per clusters
DefaultAssay(seurat_T) <- "ADT"
NOTCH2_data <- FetchData(seurat_T, vars = c("NOTCH2", "clusters_harmony"))

all_cells_med <- NOTCH2_data %>% summarize(NOTCH2_median = median(NOTCH2)) %>% pull(NOTCH2_median) #median for all cells
NOTCH2_med_fold <- NOTCH2_data %>% 
  group_by(clusters_harmony) %>% 
  summarize(NOTCH2_median = median(NOTCH2)) %>% 
  mutate(NOTCH2_median_foldchange = NOTCH2_median / all_cells_med)

df_NOTCH2_cluster <- NOTCH2_data %>% mutate(clusters_harmony = "all Tcells") %>% rbind(NOTCH2_data) %>% #compare each cluster to all cells
  wilcox_test(NOTCH2 ~ clusters_harmony, p.adjust.method = "BH", ref.group = "all Tcells") 

df_NOTCH2_cluster <- df_NOTCH2_cluster %>% left_join(NOTCH2_med_fold, by = c("group2" = "clusters_harmony")) %>% 
  select(group2, NOTCH2_median, NOTCH2_median_foldchange, p.adj, p.adj.signif) %>% 
  rename("clusters_harmony" = "group2") 


plot_notch2 <- NOTCH2_data %>% 
  left_join(df_NOTCH2_cluster, by = "clusters_harmony") %>% 
  smartbind(NOTCH2_data %>% mutate(clusters_harmony = "all Tcells") %>% slice_sample(prop = .1)) %>% 
  mutate(fold = case_when(
    NOTCH2_median_foldchange > 1.2 ~ "> 1.2", 
    NOTCH2_median_foldchange < .8 ~ "< 0.8", 
    .default = "Unchanged"),
         fold = factor(fold, levels = c("> 1.2", "Unchanged", "< 0.8"))) %>% 
  
  mutate(clusters_harmony = factor(clusters_harmony, levels = c("all Tcells",1:15))) %>% 
  slice_sample(prop = .6, by = "clusters_harmony") %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x = clusters_harmony, y = NOTCH2, col = fold)) +
  geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.5)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = .2, outliers = FALSE) + 
  # geom_quasirandom(method = "quasirandom", width=.3, size=.3, alpha = 0.1, varwidth=F, dodge.width=0.60) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = all_cells_med, color = "red",  linetype = "dashed") +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("> 1.2" = "green", "< 0.8" = "red", "Unchanged" = "grey50")) +
  labs(color = "Fold change", x = NULL, y = "Notch 2 protein") +
  theme_pubr(legend = "right") + theme_grid + theme_fonts + theme_x_angled


svglite(paste0(filepath_plots, "T_cells\\ADT_cluster.svg"), height = 3, width = 8)

plot_notch2 + theme(legend.position = "none") | plot_cd3
```
